name: cursor-remote-lite
description: Use your desktop Cursor from your phone: chat with the Agent, approve steps, switch windows/modes/models. Free and self-hosted.

scripts.reset: node -e "const d=require('os').homedir()+'/.cursor-remote-lite/';for(const f of ['url-key','devices.json','pairing.json','totp.json','config.json','state.json'])require('fs').rmSync(d+f,{force:true});console.log('已重置：所有设备需要重新配对，二次验证已关闭')"
